caelestia.role: Initial upstream source baseline; local port commits follow this commit.

quickshell.role: Windows backend and QML compatibility interfaces. Preserves nunreasonable/quickshell e8ae0ef124b1c14b547c80d00422d2ffbd423d81, native mask hover handoff, Core Audio capability/error reporting, UPower observation validity, GSMTC initialization/session-scan status, profile-isolated artwork caching, verified power profile results, confirm-only Bluetooth pairing, opt-in strict brightness routes with owned gamma restoration, explicit-consent notification mirroring, M3 tiling/Hypr window observation with allowlist scope and fitting outcomes, the single-desktop placeholder fix, 64-bit brightness query request ids, DPI-unaware tiling placement, and native virtual-desktop workspace dispatch, and global hotkeys with profile-local overrides and live reload. Typed app/screen tiling selectors and leak/crash lifetime fixes. Explorer reconnection for workspace dispatch and MTA-worker audio sessions. Foreground-thread keyboard layout and Caps Lock/Num Lock observation. Single-window outer gaps and focus/scheme DWM border colours with lifecycle restoration. Browser fullscreen suspends tiling before floating style rules; failed automatic tiling is retried on a larger physical monitor; explicit exclusions still apply during fullscreen. Opt-in QPC transition trace (QS_TRANSITION_TRACE) and a monotonic tiler clock. Fullscreen keeps its layout slot through a smaller display mode, work-area and DPI changes, rapid re-entry and a minimize on exit, with neighbours keeping their exact tiles; detection tolerates a small inset and bridges a display-mode change; reserve bars seed the panel z-order when they register below an already fullscreen application; a minimize is not treated as a fullscreen exit; a regained frame style confirms an exit whose rectangle still looks fullscreen, and the display-mode latch is bound to the exact fullscreen frame and monitor. Windows shell surfaces (task switcher, Task View, Start/Search, foreground staging, cloaked windows) are classified once and can never become tracked, fullscreen or foreground applications, nor lower the shell's top panels through an AppBar fullscreen notification. Backend dev.

m3shapes.role: Material 3 Expressive shape QML plugin. Upstream Caelestia split it into this external project (caelestia-dots/shell 24aa15ee) and pins the same revision in flake.nix/flake.lock. The Windows portable plugin build compiles and installs the M3Shapes QML module.

schemeCli.role: Dynamic Material You scheme generation. Installed into a virtual environment under the isolated combined profile, never into the repository; only its scheme/material modules are used, not the Linux theme writer.

iiWindowsReference.role: Porting and packaging reference. Its sources.lock supplies the backend pin; it is not the Caelestia UI dependency.
